FAQ
How does Kanary charge?

Here at Kanary, we offer transparent factory pricing to our clients, but assess a flat Overhead Manufacturing Fee (OMF) for our Product Development, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain services and support.

What are your lead times?

Lead-times will vary depending on product category, and location of production. Here are some broad lead-time estimates to consider:

Packaging:

China 2-3 Weeks
Production:

China - general: 4-6 weeks.
China - electronics: 2-3 weeks when the manufacturer has components on hand.
USA: 8-10 Weeks
Shipping:

Ocean Shipping (China to USA): 25 - 35 Days
Air Freight (China to USA): 5-15 Days
Fulfillment: Note that Kanary does not directly manage fulfillment operations– below are broad estimates of delivery times from recommended third party fulfillment providers.

USA (Domestic Standard): 3-5 Days
China (Direct): 7-10 Days

We work closely with brand owners, and engage with manufacturers to shorten lead-times, and plan production to mitigate any risk of supply chain disruptions.

Does Kanary handle fulfillment?

While Kanary does not directly handle fulfillment operations, we do partner with trustworthy 3rd Party Logistics Companies located in China and the USA to not only provide competitive costing, but also attractive click-to-deliver times and reliable customer experience. We know these fulfillment partners are reliable because we’ve used them for millions of shipments.

What is the process of working with Kanary?
When Kanary begins working with a brand-owner, we have them fill out a ‘Product Intake Form’.
We will then set up an introductory call to get to know the company, and the product.
Our experienced sourcing team will then assess 30-50 suppliers, and elect the Top 3 most suitable for the program.
Once there is consensus regarding the prospective manufacturer, Kanary will kick off the sampling process.
We work closely with the manufacturer to ensure that they create samples that adhere to the specifications and requirements indicated by the brand-owner.
Physical samples are then shared with the brand-owner to review and provide ultimate sign-off.
Once the product is approved, orders can be placed, and mass-production can begin!
And this is just the starting point: Kanary works to provide brand-owners with invaluable long-term support in negotiating payment terms, improving lead-times, managing QA/QC, production planning, and more.
What are your MOQ’s?

MOQs will vary depending on product category and the manufacturer— but typical MOQs for a product will correlate to the required packaging and labeling, which is around 3,000pcs. We may be able to achieve lower MOQs, but it will depend on product category and the manufacturer’s flexibility to accept a lower order quantity.

What is the price difference between China and US?

While difficult to generalize with a blanket statement, we typically estimate that products cost 30% more to make in the USA compared to China. It is recommended to inquire on a product-by-product basis.

How does Kanary handle compliance and certifications?

When Kanary begins working with a brand-owner on their product, we work with them to identify the prospective compliance and certifications that their project may require. Additionally, we consult with the manufacturer, who can often provide invaluable reference on compliance requirements for products that they’ve previously shipped.

Kanary also partners with product and packaging compliance firms that can advise on compliance requirements for specific markets— and we have extensive experience engaging with top testing firms, such as SGS, BV, and Intertek, where the required compliance testing can actually be conducted.

What is Kanary?

/kəˈnæri/ A canary is a small songbird, a finch known for its bright yellow feathers and beautiful singing. In the 1800s, Canaries were used to warn mine workers of dangerous gases in mines. And that’s how we chose our name– Kanary is always looking out for our clients, ready to warn them of potential supply chain challenges, so we can solve them before they cause disruptions.

Can Kanary make custom products?

We’re glad you asked! Yes, we can! Our team members have experience in bringing over 10,000 products from concept to shipment, across numerous categories, including, but not limited to: Consumer Electronics, Toys, IOT Devices, Clothing & Textiles, Beauty & Skincare, Supplements, Automotive Componentry, Packaging, and more!
